version: Version 3.9, April 2025; live document states updated November 2025; curated-2026-10-08

sources.title: GCSB New Zealand Information Security Manual v3.9
sources.locator: Controls identified by native section and CID; sections 1.1, 2.2, 3 and 5

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

MUST and SHOULD are preserved separately. Government protective markings and additional high-classification controls are not collapsed into this baseline. The live manual and April 2025 change overview were reviewed; no new v4.0 is presumed.
